report: WS-6c-DSPy-2-live closed the S-BS-44 prompt-parity gate (load_role_prompt .strip()s -> build_trio role prompts byte-match _load_role_prompts, regression-guarded) and ran ONE cost-confirmed live prompt-vs-DSPy A/B over proof_case n=7. The cost-confirm gate earned its keep: at plan-review it surfaced a CONFIRMED payload-shape bug (D-1) — _context_payload fed the prompt arm a top-level transcript the council reads only from call_context.transcript, which would have broken the control arm and wasted the spend. The user verified the diagnosis independently and approved the one-line harness fix (offline-tested both ways: the fix delivers the transcript; the old shape does not). The smoke then hit the user's halt condition (both arms reject a clean-negative); I halted, proved offline ($0) that the fix took, and diagnosed the reject as the DOCUMENTED transcript-only blind spot (the bug-free DSPy arm exhibits it too) rather than the payload bug; the user granted a fresh go. Full run: 42 Azure calls, 390.9s, 85.71% verdict agreement (6/7), near-identical confidence between arms (risk Delta -0.004, faithfulness 0.0), estimated ~$0.75-1.5 (within the $3 ceiling, ONE run). The real A/B signal: the Mistral policy_judge is verbose in the prompt arm (fp=22) but silent in the DSPy arm (fp=0) despite identical model/deployment/role-prompt — an elicitation-path divergence worth chasing in DSPy-3; and the DSPy faithfulness judge out-recalled the prompt arm on the labeled MISSING_ALLERGY. Absolute per-judge precision is a LOWER BOUND (S-BS-43) further saturated by the blind spot, so it is NOT read as judge precision. A3 frozen contract holds (compliance_council.py byte-identical, 0 delta vs c0a5463); scope clean (4 council files + 2 docs/research files; the 3 staged paper files NOT swept; every commit pathspec'd). PROCESS NOTE: this latent payload bug vindicates the DSPy-2 offline-only ruling + the 'test-correct but UNVALIDATED against real behavior' caveat — the live path had a real bug that only surfaced on real wiring, which is exactly why offline numbers were never reported as an A/B result and the spend was gated. The S-BS-44 close + the live A/B numbers are the deferred calibration-USP payoff of the DSPy-2 substrate.
